note: Re-judged 2026-11-23 by an independent agent after rfc4301_outbound_steps_linux_test.go changed. RFC 4301 Section 5.1 step 3b: "If no match is found in the cache, search the SPD (SPD-S and SPD-O parts) specified by SPD-ID." With no kernel SPD cache, the first packet of each flow searches SPD-S (Child SA PROTECT) and SPD-O (operator BYPASS/DISCARD and catch-all). TestRFC4301OutboundPacketTakesTheDispositionOfTheEntryItMatches and TestRFC4301OutboundPacketIsDiscardedByTheEntryItMatches verify first-packet PROTECT, BYPASS, operator DISCARD, and catch-all fallback on an unmatched port. Verdict stands.
